# Barakat Qurtas

Barakat Qurtas is an independent Kurdish graphic and motion designer based in
Erbil (Hewler / Hewlêr), Kurdistan Region of Iraq. He has more than ten years of
professional experience and a portfolio of more than 1,000 works.

Identity and name variants:
- English and Turkish: Barakat Qurtas / Bqurtas
- Sorani Kurdish: بەرەکات قورتاس / بەڕەکات قورتاس
- Arabic: بركات قرطاس

Core expertise:
- Brand identity and logo design
- Kurdish, Arabic and Latin typography
- Poster, book-cover and editorial design
- Print, stationery, advertising and social campaigns
- Motion graphics, video and AI-assisted visual production

Service area:
Based in Erbil and available for projects across Kurdistan, Iraq, the Middle
East and worldwide through remote collaboration. Project communication is
available in Kurdish, English and Arabic.

Primary pages:
- [Design portfolio](https://bqurtas.com/design) — portfolio by discipline.
- [The Journal](https://bqurtas.com/blog) — notes on typography, place and design practice.
- [Biography](https://bqurtas.com/bio) — biography, experience and skills.
- [Contact](https://bqurtas.com/contact) — project enquiries.

Panjamor Office Studio:
Panjamor is a focused studio room for name checks, logo direction, Kurdish and Latin lockups, colour palettes, type pairing, printed matter, social launch kits, production-ready exports and owner handover.

Languages:
The site is available in English, Sorani Kurdish, Kurmanci Kurdish, Arabic, French, Turkish and Swedish.

Localized homepages:
